**1 — Scene:** A rice-and-vegetable salad with two pieces of orange-seasoned grilled chicken and two corn-on-the-cob rounds.

**2 — Vessel:** A large square dinner plate, partly cropped. I’ll use an equivalent circular diameter of approximately **26 cm**, giving an area of **3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Brown rice, chicken, corn, leafy greens, red pepper, a small yellow vegetable piece (likely potato), a pale mushroom-like piece, and a light coating of oil/marinade. The small vegetable identifications are uncertain.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Footprints below are allocated without double-counting overlapping foods. Oil coats the food rather than adding a separate footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked brown rice | 22% | 117 × 1.6 = 187 ml | 0.8 | 149 | 125 | 186 |
| Corn, edible portion | 12% | 64 × 2.5 = 160 ml | 0.65 | 104 | 96 | 100 |
| Grilled seasoned chicken | 12% | 64 × 1.8 = 115 ml | 0.95 | 109 | 175 | 191 |
| Leafy greens | 4% | 21 × 1.5 = 32 ml | 0.15 | 5 | 25 | 1 |
| Red pepper | 3% | 16 × 1.2 = 19 ml | 0.6 | 11 | 31 | 3 |
| Small potato piece | 1% | 5.3 × 1.3 = 6.9 ml | 0.7 | 5 | 85 | 4 |
| Mushroom-like piece | 0.7% | 3.7 × 0.8 = 3 ml | 0.6 | 2 | 28 | 1 |
| Visible oil/marinade coating | — | Approximately 4 ml | 0.92 | 4 | 884 | 35 |

**Area check:** Allocated food footprints total **54.7%** of the plate. Corn weight represents edible kernels, not the discarded cob; its effective bulk density accommodates the cob within the rounds’ outer envelope.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **389 g and 521 kcal** is plausible for this visible quantity: a modest rice pile, two chicken pieces, two corn rounds, and only a few leaves and vegetable pieces. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **330–460 g and 430–640 kcal**.
